fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida Power & Light Company billing and high electricity costs in Miami; public safety concerns about Coral Gables rapid transit/streetcar speeds and accidents along Coral Way; notes on civic participation and paying poll taxes to vote; discussion of Dade County grand jury recommendations regarding facilities for the insane at the county stockade; and commentary on charitable fundraising and public sentiment toward the American Red Cross and the Community Chest. Also contains local columns, humor, advertisements, and extensive promotions for entertainment and sports including greyhound racing venues and Miami Beach nightlife.
